questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}P\{X>1\}&=1-P\{X\leq 1\}=1-\int_0^1e^{-\lambda}dx=e^{-2}\,,\\ \text{即}1-(1-e^{-\lambda})&=e^{-2}\,,\ \text{故}\lambda=2\,.\ \text{于是}\\P\{\min(X,Y)\leq 1\}&=1-P\{\min(X,Y)>1\}\\&=1-P\{X>1,Y>1\}=1-P\{X>1\}P\{Y>1\}\\&=1-e^{-2}\times e^{-2}=1-e^{-4}\,.\end{aligned}
